key_takeaways: We found no official average wedding cost in Australia: the ABS counts marriages, not spending, and Moneysmart's marriage and money guidance gives no average.
Survey averages blend 40-guest lunches with 200-guest receptions, count different things and are pulled upward by a few very large weddings.
Guest count, venue, date and inclusions move your total more than any national figure can predict.

Under the Australian Consumer Law, a business must not take your payment if it knows, or should know, that it cannot supply on time, but changing your mind is not covered, so read every cancellation clause.
A wedding overseas is shaped differently rather than reliably cheaper: our cost guides show the figures in their own currency and year.

faq.q: What is the average wedding cost in Australia?
faq.a: There is no current official figure. The ABS records how many couples marry, not what they spend, and Moneysmart's marriage and money guidance gives no average wedding cost. The averages quoted online come from industry surveys with different samples, years and inclusions. Your own cost depends on your guest count, city and venue, date and what each quote includes.

faq.q: Why do websites quote different average wedding costs?
faq.a: Because they measure different things. Surveys differ in who answers, which year they cover, whether they count the ring, honeymoon and attire, and whether they report the mean or the median. A few very large weddings pull a mean upward, so two honest surveys can publish very different numbers.

faq.q: What is the biggest wedding expense in Australia?
faq.a: There is no current official breakdown, so treat any ranking with care. Venue and catering are the lines to watch, because catering and drinks are often quoted per guest and grow with every name you add. Fix your guest range before you compare venues.

faq.q: Is a destination wedding cheaper than a wedding in Australia?
faq.a: Not reliably. It can cost less if your guest list is much smaller, but it can add costs a wedding at home may not carry, such as guest flights and rooms, extra days and currency movement. Compare like with like using our side-by-side guide to overseas and home wedding budgets.

faq.q: How much contingency should we keep in a wedding budget?
faq.a: There is no official percentage, and Moneysmart gives no wedding-specific rule. Agree the size with whoever is contributing, and keep it as its own line, separate from known extras such as surcharges, overtime and a wet-weather plan. Moneysmart's free budget planner lets you add custom lines for this.

faq.q: What is the cheapest month to get married in Australia?
faq.a: There is no official price data by month. ABS figures show fewer marriages in winter and over Easter and Christmas, and the most on Saturdays and in spring and autumn. Ask each venue whether its minimum spend is lower for a winter date or a weekday.

Real weddings in Italy from about EUR 20,000 to over EUR 120,000.
Lake Como: many 60-guest weddings EUR 80,000 to EUR 150,000 before flights and guest rooms.
Amalfi Coast: 60 to 80 guests EUR 60,000 to EUR 110,000 or more; landmark villa multi-day EUR 150,000 to EUR 450,000 or more.
Santorini: EUR 4,000 for an elopement to EUR 55,000 or more.
Maldives: 20-guest resort wedding USD 25,000 to USD 60,000 all-in.
